test_exported_model: test a TorchScript model by loading it and generating labels from pipe-separated input strings
run_test_exported_model_cli: run the CLI to test a scripted model file with custom input strings separated by pipes
load_scripted_module: load a TorchScript module from a file using PathManager and torch.jit.load
generate_labels_from_context: generate labels from a scripted module by building context from inputs and outputs
parse_test_args: parse command-line arguments for scripted model file path and pipe-separated test inputs
